name: Parsed::find_ast_pattern

test_list.description: A real ast-grep pattern returns its bounded syntax-node byte span.
Pattern-shaped text inside a string literal is not a syntax match.
The matcher reports a bound error instead of truncating excess results.
Byte sources that cannot be represented as AST-grep text return a typed error.

inputs.name: max_matches
inputs.description: Hard maximum number of returned matches.

inputs.name: max_nodes
inputs.description: Hard maximum syntax nodes traversed by the query.

output_description: AST pattern byte ranges over the already parsed code-intel tree.
